title: Ky Dickens' controlled telepathy tests with Mia in a rented Glendale house
summary: Ky Dickens tells of Ky Dickens' controlled telepathy tests with Mia in a rented Glendale house, about c. 2023 at Glendale, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: brought this young girl Mia up from Mexico you know most of the family didn't even speak English only her aunt Sophia did and I rented a house in Glendale California

plain: A documentary filmmaker named Ky Dickens says that in 2023 she brought a young girl, Mia, up from Mexico with her family, of whom only her aunt Sophia spoke English, and rented a house in Glendale, California. There, she says, she ran controlled tests of whether Mia could read minds, with a researcher named Diane Powell also named in the story. If the tests showed what she says, it would mean telepathy, reading thoughts without words, is real.
